title: Chapter 727
paragraphs: Chapter 727
Episode 183. The Skirmish that Began Within (2)
Quaian, one of Bi-gung's 7 Swords, wiped the cold sweat off Cyrus' forehead.
"Captain, don't tell me you've received mental attacks like Jin?"

"...Yes. There's a high possibility that Rosa's mental attacks have also begun for the Bamel Union and the temporary alliances like me. Ras, you go to Tikan and check the situation. I will cast Mote."
"Understood."
Cyrus immediately got up and headed for the training ground.
Jin, still in meditation, was in sight. Jin seemed to be struggling with cold sweat dripping, but appeared to be holding up well.
However, screams were heard from the quarters of Gilli, Valeria, and Quaol.
Among them, it was only Valeria who had received Rosa's mental attack.
She was having a seizure, as if she was hit harder than Cyrus. She was bleeding from the mouth she bit down on to hold onto her sanity.
Gilli held convulsing Valeria with his entire body. The rampant magic power, regardless of Valeria's will, left residual wounds on Gilli's body.
"Oh, our Valeria. What do we do!"
"Don't make a fuss, Quaol! It's Rosa's mental attack."
"Mental attack, you say?"
"Gilli, hold on a little longer."
Cyrus produced a chill to cool Valeria's body, and after a few minutes passed, Valeria regained her senses.
"Heuk, heuk, heuk…!"
Valeria, panting heavily.
In the illusion created by Rosa's mental attack, not only her current comrades, but she also experienced the extermination of the Grey Owl Mercenaries, which were her only family in the past.
"Are you okay?"
At Cyrus' question, Valeria nodded with a dazed face. And like Cyrus, she also felt a heartache for Jin.
From that point on.
The same thing happened in Tikan, Draka, and in the headquarters and empire of Kinzelo.
Each faction began to receive Rosa's mental attacks, one or two people at a time.
In Tikan, it was Kashimir, in Draka, it was Beradin, in Kinzelo's headquarters, it was Marjiella, and in the Empire, it was Dante who were attacked.
Surprisingly, among them, Kinzelo was the one that took the greatest hit as a whole.
"Gr, grand duke! Are you here! Marjiella is going berserk again...!"
"Please do something about our Marjiella!"
Ainas and Bubar shouted urgently.
Kwa-aaang-! Thud!
The basement of the headquarters was being destroyed by the purple aura Marjiella was spreading while running wild.
In front of them, Berakto, Jo, Bianca, Lanke, and Bischel were struggling to block the energy.
Except for Marjiella, none of the others showed such a rampage even if they were subject to the mental attacks.
Zephrine, who just arrived, immediately joined them.
"Bischel, lieutenant, you should retreat now."
Zephrine said, running over and standing next to Bischel. Bischel was seriously injured.
"She is my sister."
Originally, Bischel was one of the most calm in Kinzelo, but he always lost his composure when it was related to Marjiella.
"I know you feel guilty and indebted to Miss Marjiella. But if Marjiella were to come back, would she be happy to see you hurt?"
"I'm still fine...ugh."
Zephrine slapped Bischel's back neck. She threw the unconscious Bischel to Bubar, raising her energy.
'Why such a rampage at this time... I hope the evil god hasn't recognized the being that resides within Miss Marjiella.'
Even with Zephrine joining, Marjiella's rampage wasn't suppressed for a while.
Even though Orgal regained some strength and Zephrine also became stronger, it wasn't easy to suppress it without causing serious damage to Marjiella and the headquarters.
Marjiella's rampage stopped three hours after that.
Around that time, Orgal, who finished the meeting in Tikan, returned to the headquarters.
Orgal, who looked over the situation, frowned as if he had a headache.
[Everyone has worked hard. Especially the deputy chief must have had a hard time.]

"Master, did any countermeasures against the mental attacks come up in the meeting? If Miss Marjiella keeps rampaging like this, the temporary allies might find out about her. More than anything, it's burdensome to carry such an uncertain factor ahead of the decisive battle with the evil god."
[The existence of a countermeasure has been confirmed. But it's not something we can do.]
"Then?"
[Jin Run Kandel. He is the key this time as well.]
Orgal explained.
The mental attacks that are currently being carried out randomly on all forces can only disappear when Jin wins in the war with Rosa occurring within him.
[The mental attack that originally only applied to Jin has spread to others because he seems to be losing in his fight with Rosa.]
This was a story that Orgal heard directly from Jin when he visited Bi-Gung. Jin himself said it was a 'guess', but it was almost certain.
- The phenomenon started as I began to be pushed back by Rosa. There was no problem when I was holding out well. As you can see... my condition is not good now.
-[That's true. If you just dress shabbily, you would look like a dying person.]
It had only been half a day since Jin started living in Bi-Gung.
Having seen his weak appearance, Orgal doubted whether Jin could return to his best condition within the remaining ten days, even if the mental attacks ended immediately.
"Hmm, Master. Then if the devil gets more overwhelmed than now."
[The mental attack will spread to more people. As confirmed at the meeting just now, the number of people exposed to the mental attacks of the evil god is already increasing in real-time.]
"That's unreasonable."
[There's nothing we can do as the opponent is a god. In the worst case, we might not only have to postpone the decisive battle day... we might need to think of other measures besides Jin Run Kandel.]

"Hoo. So the best thing to do is to sit still and pray for Jin to win. While stopping Miss Marjiella, of course. At least the rest of us in Kinzelo, even if we are subjected to the mental attacks, won't rampage like that."
For a while, Orgal and Zephrine said nothing, looking at Marjiella lying in bed.
Beradin and Dante were flying in the sky over Draka, riding on the back of the Water Dragon, Tuyan.
Both of their faces were dark and haggard.
"The mental attacks are now spreading to ordinary people, Sword Emperor. The situation in the empire must be the same."
Exactly one week had passed since the mental attacks began.
Now, there were many people going mad, hearing Rosa's voice in various civilian areas.
Therefore, the temporary alliance had publicly disclosed the information about the mental attacks.
The fact is that this situation will only end when Jin overcomes Rosa's mental attacks.
Below the circling Tuyan above the square, people kneeling could be seen.
All ordinary people, with black ribbons on their chests, could do was gather in one place and pray.

"At first, I couldn't understand why people were stepping out into the square, what it meant. No, to be precise, it's the same now. It's just amazing that such an act is slightly reducing the size of despair spreading around the world."
Of course, since the mental attacks began, the despair in Beradin's map was growing, but when people gathered to cheer for Jin or pray, the proliferation of despair slowed down a little.
"That is the power of solidarity, Sir Beradin."

"You could see it that way. However, fundamentally, the end of the evil god's mental attack depends not on the solidarity of the culprits, but on the victory or defeat of a special individual, Jin. They just slightly delay the proliferation of despair. Actually, it's not even a significant level. It's closer to a futile act."
Smack!
Suddenly, Dante punched Beradin in the face.
Of course, he didn't carry aura, but Beradin shook his head momentarily from the shock that shook his whole skeleton.
"Why are you hitting me? You should know that's a great rudeness."
"Ah, it seems I've become sensitive lately. I'm sorry, your words were so bad that my fist just went out without realizing."
"I understand. But be careful, because I won't forgive the second time."
"But, Sir Beradin, can you do it?"
"Do what?"
"Can you, on your own, delay the proliferation of despair for even a moment, like the people gathered below?"
"I can't."
"Then don't say that they are doing meaningless things. No, even if it's something you can do alone, you can't insult those who have come out to do something."
"I don't understand, but I'll consider it. It seems more effective for the unity of our temporary alliance that doesn't have much time left."
"You never know. Actually, the gathering of the people could be of some help to Jin. Thanks to that, Jin might win the inner war he is fighting alone."
Dante believed that. That their power, which is slightly slowing down the proliferation of despair, would help Jin.

"So it would be good to encourage them and move to the Empire as soon as possible. People are gathering in the square of the Empire as well. You might ask what's the point of us encouraging them, but this is a very important issue. It's also the duty of a leader."
Beradin nodded without saying a word. He couldn't really agree with Dante's opinion, but he didn't want to get hit again for nothing and cause chaos.
Above all, as Dante said, if this act could help Jin even a little, it was right to do it unconditionally.
The mental attack had been going on for eleven days.
Jin was reaching his limit. He was so exhausted that he shivered even while sitting still and meditating, and he couldn't even put food or water to his lips.
Rosa's mental attack, which spread across the world, was growing every day. The number of civilians exposed to the mental attack was exponentially increasing.
What was once reported as about a hundred people per day in each area had now reached about a thousand.
There were only five days left until the final battle.
Believing that all this chaos could be resolved within that time, and that Jin could fight Rosa in his best condition, was incredibly difficult.
Sometimes, it hurts just to watch.
That was the case for Jin's companions who were watching him from the labyrinth. They thought Jin might suddenly die like this, so they felt like they were walking on thin ice.
"...I think we should delay the final battle. It would be difficult for him to participate in five days at this rate."
Gilli, looking at Jin from a distance in the training field, said.
"I've already received a message from King Tikan, Gilli. They discussed postponing the final battle indefinitely until the mental attack is over at the meeting."
"Yes, please rest, Lord. Your complexion isn't good."
"It's not like resting will make it better, this mental attack."
The moment Sirius responded, Jin suddenly got up.
His shaky legs seemed to collapse at any moment, Gilli and Sirius quickly supported him.
"Lord!"
"Jin."
"No, postponing... is meaningless."
"Then?"
"Sirius, I need to use the closed-door training room now."
"I did say I would let you, Jin. But it's too much for you to go into the closed-door training room alone with that body. If something happens to you in there, we can't help."
"I don't have the energy to explain in detail. Just open the closed-door training room. It's even hard to talk in reality right now...."
The fact that Jin was weakening in reality meant that the war taking place within him was intensifying.
Now Jin was preparing to end that fight alone, without the familiar noise of his companions serving as a landmark.
Sirius gritted his teeth and locked eyes with Jin, then nodded.
"I understand, I'll open it right away."
